tool.description: Convert a CSV table into XML: a `root` element (default 'rows') wraps one `row` element per record, and each field is <tag>value</tag> using the header name as the tag (sanitized to a valid XML name) — or col1… when header=false. Values are XML-escaped. delimiter is a single char or comma/tab/semicolon/pipe. Runs locally.

root.description: Root element tag wrapping all records (default 'rows').

header.description: Use the first row as the field tag names (default true); otherwise 'col1'… are used.

delimiter.description: Field separator: a single char or 'comma'/'tab'/'semicolon'/'pipe'. Default ','.
